description: A painted scene of an industrial ironworks. A stone blast furnace with a glowing arched opening sits on the right, with molten orange metal pouring out onto sand moulds on the ground. Three or four men in waistcoats and wide-brimmed hats work with long tools and ladles near the moulds. A worker pushes a barrow up a wooden ramp toward the furnace top, and a large wooden water wheel with spilling water stands on the left. Smoke and sparks fill the air, and dark trees frame the background.
